notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP succeeded throughout - curl_cffi impersonate=chrome, no block encountered; robots.txt has only a generic User-agent:* Allow:/ block (no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow), so all tiers permitted. TREE: scoped strictly to the 'Home' node of window.__myx_navigationData__ (the mega-menu JSON embedded in the SSR HTML of /shop/home-living), which mirrors the site's own Home & Living dropdown (Bed Linen & Furnishing, Flooring, Bath, Lamps & Lighting, Home Decor, Cushions & Cushion Covers, Curtains, Furniture, Home Gift Sets, Kitchen & Table, Storage, Brands). Apparel/fashion, Beauty, Kids, Men, Women, Genz top-level menus were not touched. QTY: each leaf fetched individually via HTTP and its own window.__myx.searchData.results.totalCount JSON field read (evidence = that field); confirmed non-fabricated by cross-checking that the unfiltered /home-furnishing (951421) and /home-furnishing-menu (951394) baselines are far larger than every filtered sub-count used here, proving the site's filter query actually narrows results rather than silently returning the parent/site-wide total. Several nav items resolve to a generic '?f=Categories:X' filter on the shared /home-furnishing(-menu) listing page whose <title>/canonical stay generic ('Home Furnishings') even though totalCount is genuinely filter-specific - these are marked confidence MEDIUM rather than HIGH. EXCLUDED (neither Textile nor Storage): Lamps & Lighting and its children (Lighting category, separate task); Home Decor group and children (Plants & Planters, Aromas & Candles, Clocks, Mirrors, Wall Decor, Festive Decor, Pooja Essentials, Wall Shelves, Fountains, Showpieces & Vases, Ottoman - all decorative accessories/wall decor/furniture, out of scope per both rule files' boundary sections); Furniture node (out of scope); Home Gift Sets (gift/collection landing page, rule 27); Dinnerware & Serveware, Cups and Mugs, Bakeware & Cookware, Bar & Drinkware (Kitchen & Dining, out of scope); Brands sub-tree (brand storefronts, not category nodes); Bathroom Accessories (fetched and inspected product sample - actual contents are mops, buckets, soap dispensers, toothbrush holders, ceramic/plastic bath accessory sets, i.e. bathroom hardware/cleaning tools, not textile and not storage/organization - excluded per storage.md keyword-ambiguity rule 42, do not classify by 'Bathroom' room name or 'Accessories' label alone); Bins node under Storage menu (fetched product sample - despite the 'Storage' menu placement, actual products are pedal/push waste dustbins, i.e. trash receptacles, not organizational storage per storage.md's actual product-type test - excluded, keyword-only 'Bins' would have been a false positive); the nav's 'Kitchen Storage & Tools' combined link (noindex, canonicalUri differs from requested slug, mixes genuine Kitchen Storage with non-storage Kitchen Tools so its single totalCount cannot be isolated to storage-only without fabricating a split) was replaced with the clean standalone /kitchen-storage page (canonical self-matching, title-matching, indexed, product sample confirmed genuine storage containers/racks/organizers) recorded instead as the Storage leaf for that branch. Hangers included in Storage at LOW confidence (plain clothes hangers - ambiguous per storage.md, included only because Myntra's own nav buckets it under the 'Storage' menu). Table Covers & Furnishings (combined noindexed multi-category link under Kitchen & Table) is flagged LOW/MANUAL REVIEW: all its constituent categories are individually Textile (table cloth/covers/napkins/placemats, oven gloves, aprons, kitchen linen sets) but its slug also folds in table-runner-type products already counted separately under the sibling 'Table Runners' node, so its totalCount may partially overlap with that row - recorded as-is (site's own number, not aggregated by me) but flagged for reviewer awareness rather than silently merged or dropped.
